FILM CENSORSHIP ACT 2002

FILM CENSORSHIP (CLASSIFICATION OF FILM) REGULATIONS 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 27(c) of the Film Censorship Act 2002

[Act 620], read together with section 15 of the Act, the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Film Censorship

(Classification of Film) Regulations 2023.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 February 2023.

Classification of film

2. The Board may classify any film which has been approved under

paragraph 10(1)(a) or (b) of the Act as specified in the Schedule.
